title: Lariciresinol protects rats from complete Freund's adjuvant induced arthritis in rats via modulation of transforming growth factor-beta and nuclear factor kappa B pathway: An in vivo and in silico study.
authors: Zhao, Xiangzhuo; Wang, Ying; Wang, Ronghua; Shen, Jingfang; Wang, Jingxu; Li, Lianju
one_liner_zh: 该研究主要探讨木脂素lariciresinol对大鼠佐剂性关节炎的保护作用，仅以分子对接初步分析其与NF-kappaB蛋白的结合，对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a severe inflammatory auto-immune disorder affecting millions of people across the globe. The current therapeutic options are not adequate to address the complications of RA. Therefore, the present study was conducted to elucidate the protective effect of lariciresinol, a lignan, against Complete Freund's adjuvant (CFA)-induced arthritis in rats. The results of the study showed that lariciresinol improves paw swelling and arthritic scores in rats as compared to CFA rats. Lariciresinol also showed a significant reduction in rheumatoid factor, C-reactive protein, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin (IL)-17, and tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases-3 level with a simultaneous increase in IL-4 level. The burden of oxidative stress was also reduced in CFA rats, as shown by reduced MDA levels and increased SOD and GPx after the administration of lariciresinol. In a Western blot analysis, lariciresinol showed a significant reduction of transforming growth factor-beta and nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) protein levels in CFA rats. To understand the binding characteristic of lariciresinol with NF-kappaB, molecular docking analysis was conducted, which showed Larciresinol interacted with the active site of NF-kappaB. Our study demonstrated the significant protective effect of lariciresinol against RA via multi-target action.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种严重的炎症性自身免疫性疾病，影响全球数百万人。目前的治疗方案不足以应对RA的并发症。因此，本研究旨在阐明木脂素类化合物落叶松脂素（lariciresinol）对完全弗氏佐剂（CFA）诱导的大鼠关节炎的保护作用。研究结果显示，与CFA大鼠相比，落叶松脂素改善了大鼠的足爪肿胀和关节炎评分。落叶松脂素还显著降低了类风湿因子、C反应蛋白、肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素（IL）-17和金属蛋白酶组织抑制剂-3的水平，同时增加了IL-4水平。在给予落叶松脂素后，CFA大鼠的氧化应激负担也得到减轻，表现为丙二醛（MDA）水平降低，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）水平升高。在Western blot分析中，落叶松脂素显著降低了CFA大鼠中转化生长因子-β和核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）蛋白水平。为理解落叶松脂素与NF-kappaB的结合特性，进行了分子对接分析，结果显示落叶松脂素与NF-kappaB的活性位点发生相互作用。我们的研究表明，落叶松脂素通过多靶点作用对RA具有显著的保护效果。
